author: Sophea Chan
text: The listing warned that the Preah Vihear access road turns to mud after heavy rain and gave a number for a driver who does it anyway. Both turned out to be exactly right.

author: Marta Nowak
text: We planned four provinces in ten days off this site alone. Ferry times to Koh Rong Sanloem were correct to the minute, which is not something I expected.

author: Daniel Okoye
text: Saved a dozen places before we flew, then had the whole Mondulkiri list offline when the signal went. The Bunong homestay was the best night of the trip.
